premise.claim: KEP-502 motivation (docs-only PR, premise check run as motivation-claims verification): RBG/RIS/RI lack status.phase today; RBG declares Progressing and RollingUpdateInProgress but the built-in controllers never write them; RBG Ready reflects all-replicas readiness without revision convergence; RIS/RI record operation failures as FailedScale/FailedUpdate conditions.
premise.patchedComponent: keps/502-workload-status-model/ (design document only; no API/controller changes in this PR)
premise.evidence: C5 green at head (results/unit-l1-at-head.txt): no json:"phase" tag in any of the three v1alpha2 status types; zero writes of RoleBasedGroupProgressing / RoleBasedGroupRollingUpdateInProgress / "Progressing" / "RollingUpdateInProgress" in internal/ and pkg/ non-test Go; FailedScale/FailedUpdate declared in v1alpha2 RIS and RI condition enums and written by statelessmode/reconciler.go:237,251 and instance_reconciler.go:191,235; RBG Ready computed purely from role.Replicas == rs.Replicas == rs.ReadyReplicas (rolebasedgroup_controller.go:783-793) with no revision check, reasons AllRolesReady/RoleNotReady at :796/:804.

findings.note: keps/502-workload-status-model/README.md:275 lists Preparing as a Progressing=True candidate reason, but it is never defined or used anywhere else in the KEP; the KEP's own rule (README.md:130) requires controller-written reasons to be valid and consistent. Fix: define it or drop it from the row.

The KEP introduces RolesNotReady (ChildReadiness family reason for Progressing, README.md:158,276) alongside the retained RoleNotReady (Ready=False reason, README.md:222,278; matches code rolebasedgroup_controller.go:804). Two machine-readable strings on the same object differing by one letter, never called out. Fix: acknowledge the distinction explicitly or rename the family reason.

README.md:413 lists InPlaceUpdateNotReady as an RI aggregated-readiness candidate reason, but the current controller writes InplaceUpdateNotReady (pkg/reconciler/roleinstance/instance_status.go:298, lowercase p) for the RoleInstanceReady condition whose reasons the KEP marks retained/compatible. Case-sensitive mismatch. Fix: match the code spelling or explicitly mark the reason as renamed.

refutedHypotheses.claim: Reviewer hypothesis during stage 1: 'RIS retains ... rolloutReplacementState' names a field that does not exist in the current API, making the KEP's retained-field inventory factually wrong.
refutedHypotheses.evidence: C1 green at head AND at base 885d655: api/workloads/v1alpha2/roleinstanceset_types.go:201 declares RolloutReplacementState *RolloutReplacementState json:"rolloutReplacementState,omitempty" in RoleInstanceSetStatus. The initial grep that suggested absence ran in a stale checkout at an older commit. All 12 retained fields named at README.md:340-341 and the three preserved RI fields at README.md:415 exist in the current API.
